Reputation decay stops bulk forgery. Idle identities lose score each epoch. A sparrow audit checks activity.

Start at 100 points. Lose 8 points per idle epoch. Fall below 60 and lose rewards. Honest work adds 6 points back. The echo ledger publishes scores.

Cost math: 1,000 clones need 3,000 units per epoch to maintain. One missed cycle costs 8,000 points. Clones bleed value. The summit pool only pays active identities. Forgery loses money.
